constraints: Setting any of paneObj's column/row count properties to zero resets (unfreezes) that property.
If a paneObj property is set to a value less than zero, the command does nothing.

params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: paneObj
params.description: Object containing frozen column and row information (columnCount, trailingColumnCount, rowCount, trailingRowCount)

sentinelValues.meaning: Explicitly designates the current spreadsheet (same as omitting sheet).
